name: Golakka Hot Springs
summary: In western Un'Goro Crater, Golakka Hot Springs send geysers skyward north of Terror Run. Fire Plume Ridge's heat draws researchers and alchemists to the steaming pools.

sections.title: Boiling Waters and Volcanic Steam
sections.body: Golakka Hot Springs bubble north of Terror Run in western Un'Goro Crater. Heat from Fire Plume Ridge drives scalding water up through the ground. It leaves mineral terraces, and geysers break across the basin. Steaming Furies prowl the pools where groundwater meets volcanic heat. Explorers, herbalists, and researchers still come to study the crater's unusual geology.

sections.title: Curious Inhabitants and Strange Chemistry
sections.body: Alchemists prize Golakka's spring water as a strong catalyst. They use it even in delicate concoctions such as love potions. Spark Nilminer, a curious visitor, perches atop the central geyser vent. Researcher Krakle comes to study how the springs reach into the crater's volcanic heart.

faq.q: Why are the springs so hot?
faq.answer: Fire Plume Ridge's volcanic system heats the springs beneath Un'Goro Crater. Magma superheats underground water, sending boiling, mineral-rich water and steam through the geysers and terraced pools.

faq.q: What creatures live in Golakka Hot Springs?
faq.answer: Steaming Furies prowl the shores and pools. Volcanic heat transforms living water into roiling, volatile steam.

faq.q: What is the water from the hot springs used for?
faq.answer: Alchemists and eccentric brewers value the water for its unusual chemical properties. Pristine spring water goes into special brews, including potent love potions.

faq.q: Who is Krakle and what was he doing here?
faq.answer: Krakle studies the geothermal link between Golakka Hot Springs and Fire Plume Ridge. He gathers observations and temperature readings around the springs.

angles.text: As a gnome, you may share Spark Nilminer's fascination with the fierce geology here. He braves the scalding pressure vents to watch geothermal forces at work.
As a shaman, you can see fire and water clash in the hot springs. Their meeting gives rise to boiling Steaming Furies along the mineral banks.
